title: Correct idea written in Nigerian Pidgin
label: Demo data — synthetic
question: Explain what lim_{x->2} f(x) means in your own words.
student_answer: E mean say as x dey waka go near 2, the function f(x) dey draw go near that same target value, even if the point self empty for real life.

chunks.text: The limit describes the value that a function approaches as the input approaches a specified value, independent of whether the function is defined at that exact point.
